title: Italy's Fiscal Gamble: Debt, Energy Bills and the Limits of EU Flexibility · 13 Oct
keywords: Italy, fiscal policy, EU deficit rules, energy inflation, Meloni government, public debt, cost of living, European Commission, trade unions, defence spending, consumer prices, Istat, Bank of Italy, energy prices, EU fiscal framework
notes: Italy is navigating a simultaneous energy-price surge and a budget squeeze that threatens to push its 2027 deficit above the European Union's 3% ceiling. The Meloni government argues that defence commitments and a sharp energy shock justify exceptional fiscal room, but critics warn that debt near 138% of GDP leaves the country with dangerously little margin. The debate is as much about who pays now as about who pays later.
